pr_body:
For in-progress snapshots it matters only that the state stable, so we can check
that the pagination is stable as well.

Fixes #78348
pr_title: Proceed with pagination even if we can't get all snapshots to be successful

review_comment:
I don't think we can do this. A. we create a test that runs/sleeps for 30s randomly and B. why even have the assertion/wait if it doesn't actually work in all cases to begin with.
We should instead find a way to more deterministically block the io in the repo or have a cleaner state await predicate I think.
Agreed, that's an ugly solution. I've been trying to find a way to deterministically coordinate the process, but haven't been successful yet. I will give it another go.
